item.title: BREAKING: Brutal new vendetta erupts in Crete – 70-year-old livestock farmer shot and tongue cut out
item.description: A 70-year-old livestock farmer in Rethymno, Crete, was shot and had his tongue severed in a brutal vendetta attack linked to the discovery of a cannabis plantation.
